# Testing and evidence

Reference: `docs/quality/HARNESS.md`. Coverage of critical correctness, not 100 % coverage.

| Change        | Must prove with                                                                              |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Formula       | Golden vectors verified independently + invariants (conservation, monotonicity) + boundaries |
| Authorization | Negative tests: other workspace, revoked member, unshared household data, support masked     |
| AI component  | Eval set per CRISP-ML(Q) gate; grounding (0 unreceipted numbers); safety E4                  |
| UI component  | Unit/interaction test, a11y check (axe), visual snapshot light/dark                          |
| Screen / flow | Playwright E2E of the happy path + one failure path; screenshots in PR                       |
| Design tokens | Contrast test (AA) for every text/surface pair in both themes; aliases resolve               |

Deterministic seeds; synthetic data only. Never weaken an assertion, lower a threshold or skip a
test to go green — fix the code, or fix the test and explain why in the PR.
